meta.title: Fix sticky scroll performance issue by using correct array for min content width calculation
meta.body_summary: Fix sticky scroll performance by using correct array for minContentWidth calculation to avoid forced layout recalculations and stuttering.

core_change_summary.description: In stickyScrollWidget.ts, changed the calculation of `_minContentWidthInPx` from using `this._renderedStickyLines` (stale) to the local `renderedStickyLines` array, and added a check for empty array returning 0.
